title: DynamicsParams
description: Macro dynamics parameters. SPEC-SIM-5: real-rate transmission (inflation + unemployment).

inflation_persistence.description: Weight on lagged inflation in the Phillips curve (0 = none, 1 = full momentum).

phillips_slope.description: How much an unemployment gap below the natural rate pushes inflation down per month.

unemployment_natural_rate.description: Long-run equilibrium unemployment (NAIRU). Decimal in [0,1] — schema-rejects percentage-point notation like 6 (meant 0.06).

real_neutral_rate.description: Real neutral rate r*: the real policy rate (nominal minus expected inflation) at which the economy is neither tightening nor easing.

okun_coefficient.description: Extra equilibrium unemployment per unit of real-rate gap (Okun-style sensitivity of slack to the real rate).

unemployment_adjustment_speed.description: Fraction of the gap to policy-implied equilibrium unemployment closed each month (lag of policy on output).
